story_pages: Zahra had a star card for Gran. She went up to the roof.
Wind hit the card and it shot off! Zahra ran down the steps with Mum.
In the yard dust hid it all. Zahra looked by pots and steps.
No card was in the dust. Then a red dot showed on a mat.
Zahra lifted the mat and found it! The star card was bent but not split.
Zahra handed Gran the star card. Gran hugged her in the yard.
questions: What did Zahra want to take to Gran?
What made the card fly off?
What mark helped Zahra find the card?

profile.name: Zahra
facts: In Marrakech, many families cool off in a riad courtyard with a bubbling fountain.
At the souk, children can spot rainbow-bright piles of spices and woven baskets.
People in Morocco often greet each other with a warm “Salam”.
profile.culture: A Muslim family in Marrakech; the souk, the riad courtyard and mint tea with Grandma.

landmark.fact: It is Marrakech’s famous square, full of life day and night.
landmark.name: Jemaa el-Fnaa, Marrakech
